source_value.trigger: Loading https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web in the recorded Chromium session, then opening the header search box and typing into it.
source_value.start_state: Frame 0 of media/motion.webm: the Web technology for developers article with the header search box collapsed and no advertisement slots painted yet.
source_value.end_state: Frames 279-347 of media/motion.webm: the HTML: HyperText Markup Language article with the breadcrumb Web › HTML, unchanged for the last 2.76 seconds of the recording.
source_value.continuity: One continuous 13.92 second, 348 frame recording at 25 fps of a single browser context; no decoded frame is uniform, so there is no cut, black frame or splice, and the median 16x16 grayscale difference between consecutive frames is 0.0/255.
source_value.interruption_or_reversal: The failed query is reversed rather than submitted: frame 64 (2.56 s) holds zzwissent-no-result-7f3c9 with only the Site search fallback row, and frame 97 (3.88 s) holds HTML with a full suggestion list, so the impossible term was cleared inside the same overlay.
source_value.feedback: Feedback is a repaint, not an animation: the search overlay replaces the article in a single frame (17.0/255 at 1.80 s), the suggestion list swaps in a single frame (7.5/255 at 3.88 s), and the answer article paints in a single frame (17.5/255 at 10.72 s); only 2.3% of all frame-to-frame comparisons differ at all, and the longest change event spans 0.08 s.
